name: artwork-v3

human_historical.label_basis: publisher historical artwork/artist metadata; captions are AI-generated and are not origin labels

sources.photo_replay: Only v2train/val/calibration used in corresponding fitting roles; v2ID subset is a disclosed photo regression test

dataset.grouping: ArtBench artist; Pixiv artwork ID including all pages; generated-art normalized prompt; photo replay original group. Artist separation not established for Pixiv.
dataset.preparation: All sources decodedRGB then256x256bilinear JPEG95,no chroma subsampling. Preserve originals privately and record both hashes.
dataset.deduplication: Encoded/prepared RGB hashes globally; cross-role dHash Hamming<=4 rejected
dataset.style_assignment: AI prompt regex: anime,manga,cartoon,comic,illustration,sketch,drawing,line art,pixel art,digital art,hand-drawn => illustration; painting/watercolour/oil/acrylic/impressionism/art nouveau/woodblock/folk art => painting. Illustration wins if both. Coarse source descriptions, not visually authenticated genres.
dataset.preflight_revision: Expanded explicit illustration descriptions to digital art and hand-drawn before any fitting or scoring: initial metadata provided fewer than registered illustration quotas.

training.selection: Tuning standardized partial ROC-AUC maxFPR0.05, fullAUC, earlier epoch. Never use test for selection.

evaluation.thresholds: Report0.5 and calibrate each model independently on calibration originals at5%empiricalFPR; lock before test.
evaluation.primary: Per-domain false-positive rate and AI recall, balancedaccuracy, confusion counts and95%Wilsonintervals. Report misses and regressions.

diagnostic.origin: User-reported non-AI Broly illustration; exact original found in Downloads, matches public filename
diagnostic.selection_use: Never use for fitting, checkpoint selection or threshold calibration; score only as a separate post-test diagnostic

limits: This is a bounded adaptation pilot, not evidence for every anime or all human-made art.
Source human/AI labels are curator assertions; no inference from appearance or detector scores.
Photo regression cases were published previously; only artwork test groups are newly withheld.
Dataset image rights remain with original artists; no raw artwork is redistributed.
No automatic exception that labels every illustration as non-AI.
The Broly diagnostic is excluded from every fitting/calibration/test aggregate.
